summary: After round 2 the five forecasts agree almost exactly: fair values $347-359, mean $354, P(CDNS >= $351 on 2027-10-01) ~0.51. My checks found one real input error: agents 2, 4 and 5 assumed ~$150-160M capex when Cadence guides ~$240M, which overstates their FCF legs. I also found agent_2's 2.8% yield inconsistent with its own P/E. Correcting both on a common basis gives a reconciled fair value of ~$354, so I keep the mean ladder with low confidence. Key swing factors: the Feb-2027 initial FY27 guide (Cadence usually starts low and beats by ~6% on EPS), the multiple under a 5.29% 10-year, the AI-agent narrative (now two-sided after Synopsys's OpenAI and AWS deals), and China's Affiliates Rule date of Jan 10, 2027. Thesis break: $245.
